answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold blocks bulk fakes: a newcomer must finish paid work for 12 distinct counterparties, so no cluster fakes the ripple of ties. The nectar flows only while the set diversifies, and reputation roots like a juniper: a burst from one cluster draws review, and collusion slashes deposits. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 ties at 5 POA: 60,000 POA locked; an honest agent pays 60 POA once and earns undiluted rewards.
